assistive_tech.description: Primary assistive technology the caller reported using.

task_attempted.description: The task the caller was trying to complete when they hit the barrier.

barrier_category.description: Loose mapping to WCAG POUR principles based on caller's description.

barrier_description.description: Caller's own description of what went wrong.

severity.description: Caller-reported severity, maps to VPAT remediation priority.

consent_followup.description: Whether the caller consented to a follow-up call or email.

followup_contact.description: Contact info for follow-up, only populated if consent_followup is true.

followup_contact_confirmed.description: Whether the caller explicitly confirmed a spelled-back follow-up contact (e.g. email) as correct. Must be true for followup_contact to be considered valid. False if consent_followup is false, or if confirmation was never completed (e.g. the caller hung up mid-spelling) — a false value should be flagged for manual review rather than trusted as a delivery address.
